escalations.question: src/renderer/src/helm/test-fixtures.ts must gain `compare` on its helmActions() factory and `incoming`/`comparing` on its helmView() factory, or T1's contract amendment leaves two TS2322 errors standing at the end of the session. T4 OWNS the file (src/renderer/src/helm/** covers it) but no criterion on any task requires the fixtures be updated, and no task carries a repo-wide typecheck criterion. Every per-task vitest run passes regardless, because vitest transpiles without typechecking. Amend T4's frozen criteria to require it?
escalations.answer: Amend both. T4 gains a criterion requiring its test-fixtures factories to carry compare/incoming/comparing; T5 gains a repo-wide `npx tsc` gate that must come back clean apart from the pre-existing TS6307 family. Fix it and gate it.

options.summary: Amend T4 and T5: fix the fixtures and add a repo-wide tsc gate
options.rationale: T4 already owns test-fixtures.ts; T5 runs last on a quiescent tree, which is the only safe place for a repo-wide gate. Fixes this instance and catches the next.
Smallest manifest change, but nothing verifies the repo typechecks at the end, so the same class of gap recurs unnoticed.
No amendment. C1 ships with two known TS2322 errors; every test still passes because vitest transpiles without typechecking, which is why it would be easy to forget.
